criteria.evidence: OSM way 869182111 is named Joyful Journeys, tagged day_care, address 600 Lindberg Road; the official operator page independently identifies Joyful Journey at 600 Lindberg Road / Lindberg-Salisbury corner. The 2014 county Z-2571 report identifies the existing single-family home and adult day-care use. Transformed OSM ring has 12 vertices, area 505.66 m², and the saved aerial overlay traces the visible roof perimeter. OSM/crowd map and roof perimeter are not a surveyed wall footprint.

The OSM ring in documented campus approximation has XY bounds [-104.046,2056.239]–[-65.915,2078.080] m and AABB dimensions 38.13×21.84 m. Saved validation reports that campus-coordinate mesh bounds preserve this ring and visually align with the independent Esri aerial; positional transform is identity. The numeric ring comparison is not independent because the baseline asset inherited the same OSM geometry; transform is approximate and source boundary follows roof edge, not confirmed wall line.

criteria.criterion: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
criteria.evidence: 2014 County report supports that the pre-use-change structure was a single-family home; aerial supports a low multi-facet roof and roof-perimeter outline. Neither source supplies a measured height, story count, pitch, or ridge plan. The 7.35 m overall height is an estimate and one-main-level/attic interpretation is unverified. Current render shows a complex roof mass but the exact ridge breaks and pitches are schematic.

No exterior building photograph, elevation, or facade plan is present in the evidence. Official operator page photos are service/home-style icons rather than views of this structure. Light siding, window rhythm, and the Lindberg-facing canopy in the model are unsupported schematic choices; no facade or entrance detail is verified.
